description: This file defines the WithThingId interface, which provides methods to access the identifier of a Thing entity. It includes a deprecated method getThingId() and a method getThingEntityId().

methods.name: getThingId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the associated Thing as a String, using the newer getThingEntityId() method for conversion.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the strongly typed identifier of the associated Thing.
